name: Baobun · Gremlet #28
description:
A steamed bun spirit that's always a little bit warm and smells like a bakery.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Baobun in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
